name: Shop & Index UI Buttons
summary: Six shop/index button variants with native editable GUI objects, hover effects and click-particle scripts.
install: Move Ui Buttons ScreenGui into StarterGui. Choose the ShopButton/IndexButton variants you need, including the alternate text and Folder variants; adjust their Position and Size for your layout. Add your own shop/index opening callbacks. Included effects are presentation, not purchases or an inventory backend.
limits: Button presentation/effects only. No shop catalog, purchase fulfillment or index backend is included. Mobile/gamepad behavior is unverified.
credit: Original supplied file and embedded script notices are retained.
verification: Static Studio Edit inspection on isolated clones; no runtime behavior certification. Native instance counts/root names matched the supplied imports. Original scripts were disabled on static preview clones.
